import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
# lab means of each candidate
print(df.groupby('lab')[cands].mean().round(3))
print()
# OLS with lab dummies for each candidate
for c in cands:
    d = df.dropna(subset=[c,'tensile_mpa'])
    m = smf.ols(f'tensile_mpa ~ {c} + C(lab)', data=d).fit()
    print(f"{c:14s} coef={m.params[c]:8.4f} se={m.bse[c]:7.4f} p={m.pvalues[c]:.4f} n={int(m.nobs)}")

# robust: add chromium only
d=df.dropna(subset=['chromium_pct','tensile_mpa'])
m=smf.ols('tensile_mpa ~ chromium_pct + C(lab)',data=d).fit()
print(m.params, m.pvalues)
